targets_custom_range.name: targets_custom_range
targets_custom_range.value: "targets"."period" <> 'custom' OR ("targets"."custom_start" IS NOT NULL AND "targets"."custom_end" IS NOT NULL AND "targets"."custom_end" >= "targets"."custom_start")

work_sessions_has_measure.name: work_sessions_has_measure
work_sessions_has_measure.value: ("work_sessions"."duration_minutes" IS NOT NULL AND "work_sessions"."duration_minutes" > 0) OR ("work_sessions"."quantity" IS NOT NULL AND "work_sessions"."quantity" > 0)
